blocks.orig: Kibanda Lodge and Restaurant is a boutique hotel located in Nungwi Beach, on the northwest coast of Zanzibar, in a magnificent area full of coconut trees, beautiful beaches and amazing coral reefs. The hotel boasts three villas with thirteen spacious and comfortable rooms. They are beautifully decorated in a contemporary design with wooden furniture, and equipped with air-conditioning, ensuite bathrooms and a private gterraces. A swimming pool with a jacuzzi, a spa and a good restaurant complete the picture, and the lodge has its very own beach club and diving centre!
blocks.html: On Nungwi Beach, along Zanzibar's northwest coast, Kibanda Lodge and Restaurant is a boutique hotel set in a magnificent area of beautiful beaches, coconut palms and amazing coral reefs. Its thirteen comfortable, spacious rooms are spread across three villas. The decor is contemporary, with wooden furniture, and each room has its own bathroom, air-conditioning and a private terrace. Add a pool with jacuzzi, a spa and a good restaurant, and the picture is complete; the lodge even runs its own diving centre and beach club!
